markdown.spec_line: The specification is the Markdown files in `spec/`. Start with `spec/vision.md`.

export.spec_line: The specification is the compiled export in `spec/`. Start with `spec/MAP.md`; account for every id in `spec/CHECKLIST.md`.

note: The export source does not exist until the owner approves the compile (DESIGN.md §6 step 3). Contradictions are not settled: the export is made with --allow-open (owner, 2026-10-01).
